title: 第6章 最痛苦的死法第20章 新特性淬身
content_zh:
“不，我好像有点低估入境的难度了。”
随着体内气血平稳，王生发现那一丝看似即将摸到的门槛，又飘散远去。
按照铜骨初段的入境标准，气血值需要达到1，才能达到入境的前置条件。
铜骨境顾名思义，是要为接下来的武道一途打下根基，需以充盈气血反哺骨骼，再以坚韧之骨驱使强劲肉身，方可称之为铜骨境。
故此，气血值1点是硬性指标，否则难以炼骨，更别谈入境。
此刻是王生，气血值的确暴涨了不少，但估摸着也就是从0.7涨到了0.8，区间大致如此。
“呵呵，一次不够那就再多来几次，反正开挂不要钱。”
王生毫不气馁，当即故技重施。
十多分钟后。
【由于你被放血身亡，你获得了「气血恢复速率增加（大）」、「表皮愈合（大）」】
【你复活了。】
“嗯？”
王生仔细感受了一下体内气血，并无变化。
“等等，难道说......”
他用刀割开掌心，却见那一丝红线刚一渗血，流血便很快止住，然后表皮就以肉眼可见的速度愈合起来。
“果然。”
一种死法对应的适配增幅，会让王生越来越难死。
真正能让特性发挥作用的不是在家里靠一把刀，而是以身涉险，去各种危险场所进行试炼，那才能快速成长。
可什么场地比较合适？
“源界裂隙......”

王生第一个想到的便是这个词汇。
这个凭空出现在世界各地的神秘空间，绝对堪称是世界上最危险的地方，也是最适合王生直接去历练的场所。
但问题是，
他一个初三学生，根本没有任何条件去接触到裂隙。
父亲当年去裂隙战场，也起码是成年后有了入境实力，这是最基本的条件。
更别提其中门道他完全不了解。
“距离中考只剩三个月了，我这下品凡骨，只靠修炼不可能短时间内增长0.2的气血......”
下品凡骨，只是让大多数普通人能摸一摸武道的路，不至于像废骨一样只能当个普通人。
但作为武骨中最差的资质，大多数人穷尽一生也到不了二境，这也是不争的事实。
“可既然死法会对应着相应增幅，那有没有手段可以让我复活后增强资质呢？”
哪怕只是从下品凡骨变成中品凡骨，修炼速度都能快上五六成啊。
死亡、复活、增幅武学资质......
这一连串念头顿时侵占了王生的大脑，他朦胧中仿佛抓到了什么东西。
很快，他一拍后脑勺：
content_en:
"No, I seem to have underestimated the difficulty of entry."
As the energy and blood in his body stabilized, Wang Sheng found that the threshold that seemed to be about to be touched drifted away again.
According to the entry standards for the first stage of Tonggu, the qi and blood value needs to reach 1 to meet the prerequisites for entry.
As the name suggests, the Bronze Bone Realm is to lay the foundation for the next step in martial arts. It is necessary to feed the bones with full Qi and blood, and then use the tough bones to drive a strong body. Only then can it be called the Bronze Bone Realm.
Therefore, a vitality value of 1 point is a rigid target, otherwise it will be difficult to refine bones, let alone enter the country.
At this moment, Wang Sheng's qi and blood value has indeed increased significantly, but it is estimated that it has increased from 0.7 to 0.8, which is roughly the range.
"Haha, if once is not enough, just do it a few more times. Anyway, there is no charge for cheating."
Wang Sheng was not discouraged and immediately repeated his old tricks.
More than ten minutes later.
[Because you were bled to death, you gained "increased energy and blood recovery rate (large)" and "epidermal healing (large)"]
【You are resurrected. 】
"Huh?"
Wang Sheng carefully felt the energy and blood in his body, but there was no change.
"Wait, could it be said..."
He cut open the palm of his hand with a knife, and saw that as soon as blood oozed from the red line, the bleeding stopped quickly, and then the epidermis healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Sure enough."
The adaptive increase corresponding to a method of death will make it more and more difficult for Wangsheng to die.
What really makes your characteristics come into play is not relying on a knife at home, but putting yourself in danger and going to various dangerous places for trials. Only then can you grow quickly.
But what venue is more suitable?
"The rift in the source world..."
This word was the first thing that came to Wang Sheng's mind.
This mysterious space that appears out of thin air all over the world is definitely the most dangerous place in the world, and it is also the most suitable place for Wang Sheng to go directly to experience.
But the problem is,
As a junior high school student, he had no conditions at all to come into contact with the cracks.
When my father went to the Rift Battlefield, he at least had the ability to enter the country as an adult. This was the most basic condition.
Not to mention that he didn't understand it at all.
"There are only three months left before the high school entrance examination. With my low-grade mortal bones, it is impossible for me to increase my energy and blood by 0.2 in a short period of time just by practicing..."
Low-grade mortal bones only allow most ordinary people to have a taste of martial arts, and they will not be like useless bones and can only be ordinary people.
But as the weakest qualification among martial arts, most people will never reach the second level in their entire lives. This is also an indisputable fact.
"But since the death method will correspond to the corresponding increase, is there any way to enhance my qualifications after resurrection?"
Even if it is just from a low-grade mortal bone to a middle-grade mortal bone, the cultivation speed can be increased by 50 to 60%.
Death, resurrection, increased martial arts qualifications...
This series of thoughts suddenly occupied Wang Sheng's brain, and he seemed to have caught something in his hazy mind.
Soon, he slapped the back of his head:
